name: The Ritz-Carlton, St. Thomas
positioning: Oceanfront resort on the east end of St. Thomas, on Great Bay, with its own sailing catamaran and boat access to St. John and the British Virgin Islands
best_for: Travelers who want to sail or day-trip to St. John and the British Virgin Islands
Families who want a Ritz Kids program, a family pool with a waterslide and watersports

facts.text: The resort is on the east end of St. Thomas, with views of Great Bay and access to the neighboring islands of St. John and the British Virgin Islands.
The resort is a 30-acre oceanfront property.
The resort has a free-form infinity edge pool and a Family Pool with a waterslide.
Alloro Restaurant serves a Sicilian-inspired menu with fresh pasta, seafood and hearty mains.
Sails Beachside Restaurant & Bar is an oceanfront restaurant by day and becomes an open-air bar at night, serving grilled steaks and seafood.
Coconut Cove Restaurant is a beachfront restaurant with an American twist, serving bites by day and grilled dishes at night.
The Three-Bedroom Presidential Suite has five full bathrooms, private ocean-view terraces, and living and dining areas.
The Club Lounge offers four food and beverage presentations each day: breakfast, a light lunch, heavy hors d'oeuvres at dinner and a dessert buffet at night.
The resort has two lighted omni-synthetic tennis courts.
The resort runs a Ritz Kids program for children.
The watersports team assists guests with Hobie Cats, kayaks, snorkel equipment and stand-up paddleboards.

highlights.text: The resort has its own sailing catamaran, the Lady Lynsey II, used for sunset sails, day sails to the British Virgin Islands, snorkeling tours and private events.
St. John is a short three miles across Pillsbury Sound, and the British Virgin Islands are a short boat ride away.
Club Level stays include access to a private Club beach.
The spa offers a Seaside Cabana Massage at the water's edge that can be shared as a couples massage.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
A daily resort fee applies, covering fitness classes, non-motorized watersports, snorkel gear, Wi-Fi and tennis court use.
